plants.name: Woodward Avenue Wastewater Treatment Plant
plants.receiver: Red Hill Creek → Hamilton Harbour (Lake Ontario)

capacity.notes: Current rated average day capacity 409 MLD; peak full-treatment capacity 614 MLD (City of Hamilton / Phase 2 project pages; AECOM). Phase 2 expansion targets 500 MLD avg / 1,000 MLD peak (Jacobs 2024). Raw wastewater PS firm capacity up to ~1,700 MLD is conveyance, not treatment. Treats ~96% of Hamilton wastewater.

influent.period: Typical municipal medium-strength (estimated; plant-specific annual averages not extracted from public PDF at compile time)

effluent.nh3Notes: Post Phase-1 tertiary: TSS monthly limit tightened to 10 mg/L and annual 6 mg/L (City HW2604, 2026). Effluent values above are order-of-magnitude defaults — mark estimated.

majorEquipment: Raw wastewater pumping station (Phase 1 rebuild; firm capacity cited ~1,700 MLD conveyance)
North/South conventional activated sludge secondary plants (nitrification upgrades Phase 1)
Chlorine contact / disinfection + Red Hill Creek outfall
Anaerobic digesters (primary + secondary) + biosolids/thermal drying program

plants.name: Ashbridges Bay Wastewater Treatment Plant
plants.address: 9 Leslie Street, Toronto, ON (raw sewage PS also at 1091 Eastern Avenue)
plants.receiver: Lake Ontario (diffuser outfall ~1000 m offshore; new outfall under construction)

capacity.notes: Rated average secondary treatment capacity 818,000 m3/d (818 MLD) per City of Toronto 2024 Annual Report / ECA 0574-CQ6J5H. peakMld uses new outfall peak hydraulic design 3,923 MLD at high lake level (Hatch / ABTP EA) — NOT secondary treatment peak; secondary clarifiers bypass at wet-weather peaks (e.g. observed ~1,754–2,588 MLD). Largest WWTP in Toronto; among Canada's largest.

influent.period: 2024 annual average (City of Toronto ABTP 2024 Annual Report Table 2 / App C)

effluent.nh3Notes: Secondary effluent annual avg TAN 9.8 mg/L (2024 App C); final effluent cBOD/TSS/TP ~8.8 / 18.2 / 0.8. Disinfection: NaOCl (UV facility under construction).
effluent.period: 2024 secondary effluent annual average (cBOD/TSS/TP); TAN from App C

ecaObjectivesMgL.notes: ECA Sewage No. 0574-CQ6J5H Schedule C (cited in 2024 Annual Report)

energy.intensitySource: 2024 hydro 134.7 GWh / 210,921 ML annual flow ≈ 639 kWh/ML (City ABTP 2024 Annual Report §6)
energy.chpNotes: Digester gas used for process/space heating; historical Toronto Hydro biogas CHP proposal (~8–10 MW) — current on-site CHP kW not confirmed in 2024 annual report.
majorEquipment: M & T Buildings raw sewage pumping + gravity Coxwell Trunk
P & D Buildings screens + aerated grit (FeCl2 dosing)
11 step-feed aeration tanks + 10 blowers; 11 final clarifiers
12 dewatering centrifuges + truck loading / on-site pelletizer
NaOCl disinfection (UV facility in construction); Lake Ontario outfall (~1000 m) + new 3,923 MLD outfall project
